title: "Publications"

listing:

      citation-detail: "Year, vol: pages"

  - id: working-papers
    contents: "research/working-papers/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: table
    page-size: 100
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [authors, title, pub-journal, citation-detail, doi]
    field-display-names:
      authors: "Authors"
      pub-journal: "Venue"
      citation-detail: "Year"
      doi: "DOI"

date-format: "YYYY"
